description: Today, Conservative Republican State Representative Charlie Meier filed his petitions to run for re-election in the 109th District, submitting over 1,700 signatures, over three times the required number, in an outpouring of grassroots support.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Citizens for Charlie Meier
title: Conservative State Rep. Charlie Meier Files for Re-Election — Charlie Meier for State Representative
